source: user visual review after 35-image wall evidence integration
observations: The wall core must be an independent adjustable system with direct controls for total width and taper.
The core opening must follow the timber frame and lintel so the jambs and head remain geometrically closed under parameter changes.
Adobe blocks and plaster are surface layers governed by the wall core contract and must rebuild when the wall core changes.
The earthen wall body visible in the supplied photographs is deep brown and must remain visible at joints, the door reveal and the wall top.
implementationDecisions: Create three closed wall-core solids around the opening.
Derive the opening from door clear dimensions, timber frame section and adjustable masonry overlap.
Expose wall width, side taper, depth taper, top core reveal and soil darkness as direct controls.
Regenerate stone, adobe, plaster and timber layers from the same contract.
